updateTime.description: Timestamp of the last update of this document

reportName.description: Name of the source report the document was ingested from

reportFolder.description: Folder of the source report the document was ingested from

session_id.description: Identifier of the CADIP acquisition session, used as the consolidated document identifier

num_channels.description: Number of channels used during the acquisition session

mission.description: Mission the satellite belongs to (e.g. S1, S2), derived from the satellite identifier

ground_station.description: Ground station where the acquisition pass was performed

station_unit_id.description: Identifier of the ground station unit

publication_date.description: Publication date of the session on the CADIP interface

downlink_orbit.description: Downlink orbit number of the acquisition pass

antenna_id.description: Identifier of the antenna used for the acquisition

antenna_status.description: Status of the antenna during the acquisition pass

front_end_id.description: Identifier of the front-end used for the acquisition

retransfer.description: Flag indicating whether the session is a retransfer

front_end_status.description: Status of the front-end during the acquisition pass

planned_data_start.description: Planned start time of the data acquisition

planned_data_stop.description: Planned stop time of the data acquisition

delivery_bitrate.description: Computed delivery bitrate of the acquisition pass

downlink_status.description: Status of the downlink step of the acquisition pass

delivery_push_status.description: Status of the delivery push step of the acquisition pass

global_status.description: Overall status of the acquisition pass (OK, NOK or INCOMPLETE) derived from the antenna, front-end and delivery push statuses

interface_name.description: Name of the interface the data was collected from

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service that provided the data

production_service_name.description: Name of the production service that provided the data

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the last CAMS ticket attached to this acquisition pass

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the last CAMS ticket attached to this acquisition pass

cams_tickets.description: Identifiers of the CAMS tickets linked to this acquisition pass

cams_origin.description: Origin of the linked CAMS ticket(s)

cams_description.description: Description of the linked CAMS ticket(s)

ErrorTFs.description: Number of transfer frames in error, aggregated across all channels

CorrectedTFs.description: Number of corrected transfer frames, aggregated across all channels

DataTFs.description: Number of data transfer frames, aggregated across all channels

CorrectedDataTFs.description: Number of corrected data transfer frames, aggregated across all channels

TotalChunks.description: Total number of chunks, aggregated across all channels

AcquiredTFs.description: Number of acquired transfer frames, aggregated across all channels

fer_data.description: Frame error rate of the data, computed as UncorrectableTFs divided by AcquiredTFs

UncorrectableTFs.description: Number of uncorrectable transfer frames, aggregated across all channels

ErrorDataTFs.description: Number of data transfer frames in error, aggregated across all channels

UncorrectableDataTFs.description: Number of uncorrectable data transfer frames, aggregated across all channels

TotalVolume.description: Total acquired data volume, aggregated across all channels

delivery_start.description: Earliest delivery start time across all channels

delivery_stop.description: Latest delivery stop time across all channels

quality_infos.description: Per-channel quality information of the acquisition session

AcquiredTFs.description: Number of acquired transfer frames on this channel

SessionId.description: Identifier of the acquisition session for this channel

ErrorTFs.description: Number of transfer frames in error on this channel

CorrectedTFs.description: Number of corrected transfer frames on this channel

UncorrectableTFs.description: Number of uncorrectable transfer frames on this channel

DataTFs.description: Number of data transfer frames on this channel

ErrorDataTFs.description: Number of data transfer frames in error on this channel

CorrectedDataTFs.description: Number of corrected data transfer frames on this channel

UncorrectableDataTFs.description: Number of uncorrectable data transfer frames on this channel

DeliveryStart.description: Delivery start time on this channel

DeliveryStop.description: Delivery stop time on this channel

TotalChunks.description: Total number of chunks on this channel

TotalVolume.description: Acquired data volume on this channel

from_acq_delivery_timeliness.description: Timeliness between acquisition and delivery, computed from downlink_start to delivery_stop
